{{Top|leg}}
A '''flash mine''' was an explosive device designed to stun its target by using either a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] or a capacitor as a discharge source. After being set, the mine had a specific distance radius, that when disturbed, would trigger the mine. With the appropriate skills, it was possible to avoid, disable or recover this mine.
